newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian reindeer face starvation after floods.
newsitem.headline: Russian reindeer face starvation after floods.

text.p: Up to 30,000 reindeer in Russia's remote northeast region of Chukotka face starvation after flood waters froze, cutting them off from their pasture land, Itar-Tass news agency said on Wednesday.
The animals can only survive another two or three days without food and will then start dying in large numbers, the head of the local civil defence service Yuri Zhulin told Tass.
The emergencies ministry has sent out helicopters and off-road vehicles in search of new pastures for the reindeer, he said.
